scope: Complete per-glyph Korean dictionary order, direction, boundary and form crosscheck. Not exam-body certification.

entries.notes: Glyph form differs: the dictionary writes 靑 with the 円 lower part (a short middle vertical as stroke 18), while the pinned MM candidate writes 青 with 月 (an inner bar). Strokes 1-17 and 19 match, but a vertical cannot be derived from the bar's own points; fail closed. The Ja corpus keeps the 靑 form (瀞 in batch 12), so a Ja re-pin may recover it later
